message: I am thinking...: Candidate paths: (1) logfmt parser quoted value with value_escape causes flb_unescape_string_utf8. (2) json parser via flb_pack_json pack_string_token uses same unescape. (3) decoder escaped_utf8 for AAA key through parser_decoder. The recent commits around OSS-Fuzz likely deal with Unicode surrogate/incomplete \u handling in flb_unescape.c, so focus on feeding JSON/logfmt string escapes. The harness first byte selects parser; logfmt is easiest because no JSON tokenizer restrictions around invalid surrogate maybe it simply passes quoted value to unescape.
